US Voters Express Concerns Over Economy Ahead of Midterm Elections

Ahead of the US midterm elections, key voter groups, including independents and those who previously voted for Donald Trump, are expressing frustration and disappointment regarding the economy. A significant portion of voters believe the country is in a recession, with many stating the economy has worsened. These sentiments are influencing their choices in the upcoming elections, with some voters indicating their regret over past support for Trump due to economic conditions like high grocery prices.
